page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs derived from 8 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, with Geekbench single-core and single-threaded gzip compression scores falling into the bottom 10% and 25% tiers respectively. However, multi-core execution scales to average levels, as demonstrated by stress-ng multi-core CPU performance and Geekbench multi-core scores. Memory bandwidth also registers in the average tier, reaching 76.43 GB/sec for large-block read operations and 55.34 GB/sec for large-block write operations.

Given the 128.0 GB memory capacity paired with average multi-core processing, this instance is suited for memory-intensive workloads that do not demand high single-thread compute speeds. Appropriate applications include database operations, caching layers like Redis (which benchmarked at 11.3 million operations per second), and moderate web serving. The lack of local storage and lower single-core performance are key tradeoffs, positioning this server as a cost-efficient option for memory-heavy, throughput-balanced enterprise tasks rather than high-performance computing or intensive single-threaded execution.
